name: minepthe-system
description: MINEPTHE - Smart Academic Book Sharing & Matching System

scripts.install:all: npm.cmd --prefix backend install && npm.cmd --prefix frontend install
scripts.seed: node -e "const { pool } = require('./backend/config/db'); const fs = require('fs'); pool.query(fs.readFileSync('./database/seeds.sql', 'utf8')).then(() => { console.log('Database seeded successfully!'); process.exit(0); });"
